name: Raphael
title: God's Healer and Messenger
summary: Raphael is an angel mentioned in the apocryphal Book of Tobit, where he appears as God's messenger and healer. The name means 'God heals,' and he plays a central role in helping Tobit and his family. In the canonical Bible, he is not mentioned by name, but he is an important figure in Jewish and Christian tradition as one of the archangels.

keyEvents.title: Raphael Sent by God
keyEvents.description: Raphael is sent by God to help Tobit, who is blind, and Sarah, who is tormented by a demon. He disguises himself as a human travel companion named Azariah.

keyEvents.title: The Journey with Tobias
keyEvents.description: Raphael accompanies Tobias on his journey and advises him on how to catch a fish whose internal organs have healing properties.

keyEvents.title: Exorcism of the Demon
keyEvents.description: Raphael guides Tobias in driving out the demon Asmodeus from Sarah by burning the fish's heart and liver, so they can marry safely.

keyEvents.title: Healing of Tobit
keyEvents.description: Raphael instructs Tobias to use the fish's gall to heal his father Tobit's blindness, and Tobit regains his sight.

keyEvents.title: Raphael Reveals His Identity
keyEvents.description: After the mission is completed, Raphael reveals his true identity as one of the seven angels who stand before God's presence, and he encourages them to praise God.
